Layan Green Park Phase 2

Condominium in Cherngtalay (Choeng Thale), near Layan Beach
HomeNew ProjectsLayan Green Park Phase 2

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

Layan Green Park Phase 2 is a seven-storey eco-oriented condominium in Cherngtalay, Thalang, Phuket, close to Layan Beach. It comprises five buildings with 377 units, ranging from studios to three-bedroom units and duplexes, some with private pools. The project advertises EDGE Advanced green certification and extensive resort-style facilities.

Facilities & amenities

  • Five swimming pools
  • Restaurants and bars
  • Wellness center and spa
  • Yoga terrace
  • Technogym fitness club
  • Kids club and playgrounds
  • Coworking and event spaces
  • BBQ area
  • 24/7 security and CCTV
  • Covered parking
  • Landscaped gardens
  • Vertical gardens on facades

Frequently asked questions

Where is Layan Green Park Phase 2?

Layan Green Park Phase 2 is a eco condominium / aparthotel-style resort condo project in Cherngtalay (Choeng Thale), near Layan Beach, Phuket, developed by VillaCarte Group.

What is the starting price of Layan Green Park Phase 2?

Agent advertised price is ฿7,500,000, last checked 2026-11-14. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at Layan Green Park Phase 2?

Sources list freehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will Layan Green Park Phase 2 be ready?

Current status: under construction. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
